S4-iteration.remaining: Do not flatten member boundaries or infer portable map entry order. Complete typed iteration combinations and host bindings remain outside bounded controls.

S6-update.remaining: Do not generalize structural updates to all nominal/static/package/recursive record combinations.

S8-patterns.remaining: No claim of complete declaration/import/package visibility, every composite pattern, generic JNode dispatch or earlier-profile promotion.

REQ123-jnode.remaining: The six generic-model unmet controls are retained known boundaries, not a new full-model adoption or template-rule certification.
